<thought>To find a suitable one-step retrosynthetic transformation, I will search the template catalog for reactions that break an alkene (the diene) and form a new cyclohexene ring, i.e., a Diels‑Alder reaction. This should match the target bicyclic β‑keto‑ester. I will request templates that break an alkene and form an alkene.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COC([C@]12CC=CC[C@H]1C(C2)=O)=O",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["alkene"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["alkene"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
